title: Lockup Special Investigation
description:
S1 E2 — Lake County Juvenile Justice: Aaron, Ayryana, Marie
Figuring out what contributes to kids getting locked up is not an exact science; over the past six years, Aaron has become a familiar face at Lake County Juvenile; with his 18th birthday just days away, he finds himself back behind bars.

title: Lockup: Orange County: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Wake Up Call
Confinement takes a dark turn for a light-hearted teenager, but provides a new beginning for an old bank robber inside the Orange County Jail; a mother who has put drugs before her son gets another chance.

title: Lockup: Orange County: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Highs and Lows
The Emergency Response Team have their hands full of a sadistic murderer who transforms the jail, a roller derby queen who takes a hard fall and one inmate who realizes that even a good day in jail can have a dark side.

title: Lockup: Tampa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — The Company You Keep
An inmate with suspicious tax forms becomes a problem for the jail, and a murder ends with the victim burned alive in a dumpster, pitting friends and family against each other.

title: Lockup: Charleston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Tempt Not a Desperate Man
The survivor of a vicious attack shares his story in the hopes that other inmates will never commit such violence; for another inmate, it's too late to turn back the clock and now the pain of incarceration has begun to take a toll.

title: Lockup: Cincinnati: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Killing Clouds
An online post from a diehard Dodgers fan leads to his arrest at a Reds game; a tragic shooting leaves one inmate facing prison time and outrage over his punishment leads to more arrests.

title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Pros and Cons
A low-level offender increases his sentence from 18 months to 16-and-a-half years after three separate counts of aggravated battery on an officer; the same inmate was banned from even non-contact visits after an affair with a prison staff nurse.

title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Institutionalized
Inmates who become disruptive at the Penitentiary of New Mexico are transferred to the lock-up units in level 5 or 6; the trouble is, their behavior doesn't always improve; this is a lesson rookie officer Amy Lee is learning the hard way.

title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — War
Prison officials initiate a shakedown after gang members in Level 6 overpower an officer in the recreation area, take her keys and stab a rival gang member; this type of incident simply adds to the tension already felt in the supermax facility.

title: American Greed
description:
S9 E11 — "Vintage" Wine Fraud
A counterfeit wine dealer dominates the fine wine scene, making millions selling his cheap basement blends through elite auction houses.

title: American Greed
description:
S14 E12 — A Father's Fraud
Karl Karlsen is a hardworking man with what seems to be a terrible streak of bad luck, as his wife and son both die in accidents nearly 20 years apart; Karl has a secret: their suspicious deaths have been keeping his bank account full.

title: American Greed
description:
S12 E16 — Just a Dollar and a Scheme; Lousy Landlord
An Iowa man rigs a $16.5 million lottery jackpot, triggering the biggest lottery scam in American history; notorious New York City landlord Steven Croman finds a new home in jail.

title: American Greed
description:
S15 E2 — Theranos CEO on Trial
Former employees, whistleblowers, and even a family friend-turned-foe provide new insights into the company's leadership and the mysterious long-term relationship between Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes and her top deputy, Sunny Balwani.

title: American Greed
description:
S9 E14 — Friends Without Benefits
Mutual Benefits buys life insurance policies from AIDS patients, the chronically ill and seniors and fraudulently resells them as low risk investments to clients.

title: American Greed
description:
S9 E15 — The Spy Who Scammed Me
A private security contractor promises to help win the freedom of detained oil executives and claims he can find out who abducted Madeleine McCann.

title: American Greed
description:
S15 E22 — Drunk With Power
With his long beard, ponytail, and ubiquitous advertising, Jamie Balagia - AKA The DWI Dude - is well-known in Texas as a flamboyant defense attorney who can get drunk driving defendants out of a jam.

title: American Greed
description:
S15 E23 — Fame, Fortune & Fraud
Jason Van Eman is a B-list actor from Oklahoma who decides to seek fame and fortune as a Hollywood producer.
